description: Initial particle-free, full-3D 4:1 planar contraction; dimensional SI units.

cross.description: Optional elasticity-free PEO control, exact Cross law expressed as Carreau-Yasuda
cross.density_source: Same carrier density as the PEO viscoelastic case
cross.parameter_provenance: a=0.718 and n=1-a make the Carreau-Yasuda exponent (n-1)/a exactly -1, reproducing the paper's Cross viscosity. Optional control, not an additional experimental medium.

peo.description: 1 wt% aqueous PEO, selected two-mode exponential simplified PTT
peo.density_source: main.pdf section 2.4 uses water density for PEO; the stated water density is 998 kg/m3
peo.parameter_provenance: User-selected rheology fit; eta_s is an effective background viscosity, not independently measured water viscosity. CaBER time is assigned to the longest model relaxation time. Normal and extensional stresses remain model predictions.

analysis_defaults.inlet_particle_concentration: Not imposed: report fluid approach flux or normalize by Q; multiply by a separately specified uniform reference concentration if desired.
analysis_defaults.flux_definition: Integral over a finite wall-offset surface of max(-U dot n_wall_into_fluid, 0) dA. This is gross inward advective volume flux, not adsorption rate or unique-particle capture efficiency.
analysis_defaults.wall_stress_definition: Tangential projection of (2 eta_s D + summed polymer tau) dot n. Pressure cancels from tangential traction. Newtonian uses 2 eta D.
analysis_defaults.sharp_corner_caution: Do not use a sharp-corner pointwise maximum stress as a mesh-convergence target. Compare fixed physical regions with corner exclusion, area-weighted statistics and integrals.
